S1 repaired-watchtower: Fresh yellow courses on an old grey tower: the one piece of the rim line the banner rebuilt
S2 weathered-fortification: The earlier holders' rim wall, sand-scoured to its footings along the plateau edge.
S3 weathered-fortification: An old breach in the south-west wall closed with mud brick and never refaced.
S4 levy-yard-vs-noble-architecture: A sand parade court and a one-room levy house; across the basin the allied Great
House's domed palace stands on its mesa.
S5 merchant-road: The causeway across the flats, its marker towers stepping toward the capital; caravans rest in the
S6 unfinished-structure: A second cistern cut and walled to 3 m, waiting for its vault.
S7 ceremonial-place: Eight empty lamp niches in the arcade piers before the iwan.
S8 empty-character-position: The nominated representative's marked stone on the parade sand, occupied or empty
S9 water-memory: Water enters at the lord's cistern and falls terrace by terrace past every door: who may draw from
the rill is written on its basins.
S10 older-house-ruin: A courtyard house sealed with the previous holders' mark; sand drifts against the door.
S11 class-contrast: A windcatcher and a fountain court for the merchant; three storeys of works families; a single
S12 boundary-dispute: Two well markers at the oasis edge, set a few paces apart by houses that share the same water.
